summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc furnished a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 trading update for the period ended 2 October 2026 and an interim dividend declaration. Reported revenue rose 6.5% in Q3 (5.8% FX-neutral) and 5.1% year-to-date (6.0% FX-neutral), with Q3 volumes up 3.5% days-adjusted and 2.7% year-to-date. The filing mirrors a prior 3 November 2026 6-K, furnished solely to incorporate information by reference into existing Form S-8 registration statements. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are present; this is a routine quarterly operational and dividend disclosure, not a special situation.
